purpose: Teach: 原型/員数/及ぶ/お上/摘発/人並み/語り口/長らく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、原型、絶対、まとめろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need the research prototype compiled. Seriously. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Measured pace. A boss speaking to someone he respects, giving clear orders without inflection. The weight in the words, not the volume.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験参加者、本気で、絶対、員数、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the participant headcount. Thank you for trusting me with this.
lines.style: Clipped, almost formal. Slight tension in the syllables — eager to show he's handling it. A junior researcher speaking to his mentor, careful but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文影響、本気で、絶対、海外まで、絶対、及ぶ、絶対、よう励め、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — make sure this paper's impact reaches overseas. Keep pushing.
lines.style: Steady instruction. Slightly warmer than the first line — less command, more encouragement. Leans forward slightly in tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、お上、絶対、と、絶対、政府、絶対、研究、絶対、関心ご対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm already coordinating with the relevant authorities and government bodies about the research interest. I'm on it.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly formal. Speaking as though checking items off a list. No hesitation — he's done the work, now he's reporting it. Quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文捏造、本気で、絶対、摘発、絶対、絶対なきよう励め、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — make absolutely certain there's no fabrication in this paper. Not a hint of it.
lines.style: Firmer than the previous direction. The words land with weight. Not angry, but serious in a way that shows this matters beyond the academic record.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。同期は、本気で、絶対、人並み、絶対、以上の、絶対、研究者、絶対、おります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My peers are solid researchers — as good as or better than most. I trust their work completely.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. He's not bragging — he's answering honestly. Slight lift at the end, as though he's been asked a real question and he's giving a real answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会発表、本気で、絶対、語り口、絶対、磨け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — polish your presentation skills. The way you speak matters when you're presenting at conferences.
lines.style: A note of mentorship here. Still direct, but with the tone of someone passing on experience. Slightly slower, like he's thought about this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、長らく、絶対、ご指導、絶対、いただきありがたく存じます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm genuinely grateful for all the guidance you've given me over this time. It's made all the difference.
lines.style: Sincere, formal close. Warm undertone. He slows slightly on the gratitude — not gushing, but meaning it. The kind of thanks that lingers a moment.
